_about: 图鉴 — the codex, the ONE picture system (Hanli 2026-09-29: 「图片作为图鉴，展示人物、生物、物品、武功、经脉、穴位等」). One entry per subject, one source for the book (read-md.js) and the game (the stage's first-appearance card, Ling's Show, 录's 图鉴): scripts/codex.js resolves and draws them. People, creatures, items and arts are LINKED — every row of people.json, creatures.json (not the foe- stand-ins), items.json and arts.json is an entry under its own id, its name, line and art read from there; an entry here with that id only adds to it: `first` {book: the 回's id in book.json (h01 = 第一回), scene: the game scene that introduces it}, `name`/`lines` to override, `image: null` to refuse a picture (`_image` says why; a name card stands instead). Knowledge (经脉, 穴位, 洛书, 五行 …) lives here whole: name, 2–3 lines, image, source, and `marks` (scripts/marks.js). A picture painted for us (Codex) shows NO credit line on the page (his, 2026-09-29) — its provenance is `_credit` and CREDITS.md; an old print keeps its short source line and the 「原图」 button. The hero has one entry, `xiaoman` — 沈小满 at twelve (Hanli, 2026-09-30: 「也给沈小满和阿禾来个人物图鉴」); the dialogue box still shows no face for him. Lines name him in full, 沈小满, and never say 你 (the same lines show in the book, which is in the third person). The book writes [words]{注=id}: a subject's card sits after the paragraph of its first appearance (first.book), later mentions are a dotted link; a knowledge figure sits under every paragraph that names it.
_marks: The animation layer (scripts/marks.js): ratio = the image's height/width; points [{id, label, x, y}] and paths [{id, d: [[x, y]…], through: [point ids, in flow order]}], x/y in 0–1 of the image, drawn as an SVG over it.

物品._only: An item is an entry only when codex.json tags it 法宝 · 丹药 · 功法 · 信物 (his, 2026-09-29: 「鹿皮就不用图鉴了」): a thing the reader would not know, or a named story object. Everyday things — 鹿皮, 萝卜, 饼, 碗, 爷爷的弓 (a bow is a bow) — have none.

zh: 马三的儿子，比沈小满大两岁，穿绸子
en: Ma San's son, two years older than Shen Xiaoman, in silk

zh: 蒙山脚下石坳村，猎户家的独子，这一年十二岁。身上的衣裳是爹的旧衣裳改的，爹的又是爷爷的改的；背上一张打了补丁的旧弓。若问他有什么特长，只有一样：饿。
en: The only son of the hunter's family in Shi'ao Village under Mount Meng, twelve this year. His jacket was cut down from his father's, and his father's from his grandfather's; on his back, an old patched bow. Ask what he is good at, and there is only one thing: being hungry.

zh: 邻家姑娘，比沈小满小一岁；她家也欠马家的租
en: The girl next door, a year younger than Shen Xiaoman; her family owes the Mas rent too

zh: 邻居，种地的，阿禾的爹
en: The neighbour, a farmer; Ahe's father

zh: 外门弟子，灵根比沈小满当初还差；他娘给他缝了一个护身符
en: An outer disciple whose roots are worse than Shen Xiaoman's once were; his mother sewed him a charm

zh: 漳水底下守了两千年的河伯，本名冰夷，也叫冯夷。人的脸，脚下踩着两条青龙，一双眼睛比漳水还深。他不娶媳妇。
「冰夷人面，乘两龙。」——《山海经 · 海内北经》
en: The River Lord who has kept watch under the Zhang for two thousand years; his own name is Bingyi, or Fengyi. A man's face, two green dragons under his feet, eyes deeper than the river. He does not take brides.
"Bingyi has a man's face and rides two dragons." — Classic of Mountains and Seas, Within the Seas: North

_credit.zh: 本地画手（FLUX.2 klein 4B）所绘，2026-09-29，据《山海经·海内北经》「冰夷人面，乘两龙」；两龙一人，经人眼校过（tools/paint-flux-codex.py）。
_credit.en: Painted with the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-29, after the Shanhaijing line; one man, two dragons, checked by eye (tools/paint-flux-codex.py).

yinyue._lines: What the hero knows at her first appearance (00-yinyue, dawn in the cave): a girl with one silver tail, who says she is 青丘之主 and, after a while, 银月 — never more (spoiler rule, 2026-10-01: the card read 「巴掌大的银狐」 under 人物 while the scene showed the girl). The nameless fox of the pit is `yinyue-fox`, which folds into this.

_credit.zh: Codex（gpt-5.5 图像生成）所绘，2026-10-01，据第一回「看着比他大不了几岁」：十四五岁的姑娘，银发过腰，赤脚，白衣，金瞳竖仁，一条银尾（断口只在书里，画上不画，Hanli 2026-10-01「断口去掉就好」）；经人眼校过（tools/paint-codex.py）。
_credit.en: Painted with Codex (gpt-5.5 image generation), 2026-10-01, after 第一回 (「看着比他大不了几岁」): a girl of fourteen or fifteen, silver hair past the waist, barefoot, white robe, gold slit-pupil eyes, one clean silver tail (the eight stumps stay in the words, not the picture: 「断口去掉就好」); checked by eye (tools/paint-codex.py).

zh: 洞口坐着的姑娘：银发垂腰，赤着脚，金色的眼睛，瞳仁竖着；身后一条银尾，尾根八道断口。
自称青丘之主，憋了半天，才想起自己叫银月——别的，她想不起来了。
en: The girl at the cave mouth: silver hair to her waist, bare feet, golden eyes with slit pupils; one silver tail behind her, eight cut stumps at its root.
She calls herself mistress of Qingqiu, and only after a long while recalls she is Yinyue — the rest she cannot recall.

yinyue-fox._about: 银月 as the hero first sees her, in the valley pit (a scene with `her: fox`, rules/codex.mjs): a little silver fox, nameless — the hero learns her name only at dawn (00-yinyue), where the 银月 entry takes over; `becomes` folds this one into it in 录's 图鉴.

zh: 坑底泥水里的一只小银狐，毛如月霜；只剩一条尾巴，尾根八处断口。
en: A little silver fox in the muddy pit, its fur like frost on moonlight: one tail left, and eight stumps at its root.

zh: 吴婆婆塞给沈小满的小木牌，磨得发亮；刻着一只蜷着的狐狸，尾巴绕着身子——数一数，九条。
en: The little wooden token Granny Wu pressed into Shen Xiaoman's hand, worn bright; carved with a curled fox, its tails wrapped round it — count them: nine.

zh: 督脉沿脊背正中上行，小周天的气从这里往上走，要过三道关。
尾闾在尾骨尖，夹脊在两肩胛之间，玉枕在后脑。
三关过了，气从头顶下来，沿任脉回到丹田——这就是小周天。
en: The Du channel runs up the middle of the back; the small circuit's qi climbs it through three passes.
Weilü at the tip of the tailbone, Jiaji between the shoulder blades, Yuzhen at the back of the head.
Past the three, the qi comes over the crown and back down the Ren channel to the dantian: the small circuit.

_credit.en: Painted with Codex (the back, the Du channel's three passes), labels checked by eye; the passes placed after the Xingming guizhi.

zh: 银月给的一颗黑丸子，化在水里泡一夜，洗筋伐髓。
「疼，别喊。」
en: A black pill from Yinyue: dissolved in water and soaked in overnight, it washes the sinews and marrow.
"It hurts. Don't shout."

zh: 瞿老扔给沈小满的一卷薄书。「上有黄庭下关元，后有幽阙前命门」——三丹田，这回自己练。
en: A thin book Elder Qu tossed to Shen Xiaoman. "Above is the Yellow Court, below the Origin Pass; behind the Hidden Gate, before the Gate of Life" — the three elixir fields, his to train now.

zh: 太一宫的弟子，一身白衣，腰悬长剑，站在漳水边的老柳树下，便如一棵挺拔的松树。「因为天下，该归于一。」
en: A disciple of the Taiyi Palace, in white with a long sword, standing under the old willow by the Zhang like a young pine. "Because all under heaven should be one."

zh: 邺城城西老胡家的闺女，卖豆腐，哑巴，长得俊。豆腐坊的账一向是她来记。
en: Old Hu's daughter from the west of Ye, who sells tofu; mute, and lovely. She keeps the tofu shop's accounts.

zh: 河伯庙里的巫祝，年年和三老挨家挨户收「河伯钱」，挑谁家的姑娘做河伯的媳妇。
en: The shaman of the River Lord's temple, who with the Three Elders collects the River Lord's money door to door each year and picks whose daughter becomes his bride.
